items.question: How far did the Columbia Gorge drift downriver into the historic lock after it broke free from its mooring at Cascade Locks?
items.expected_answer: It drifted about 475 yards downriver into the historic lock.

evidence.quote: The vessel drifted about 475 yards downriver into a historic lock and damaged tribal fishing platforms mounted on the lock walls before its stern became wedged beneath the Thunder Island pedestrian bridge, which spanned the lock.

items.notes: Tests retrieval of the drift distance, stated only in the analysis.

items.question: Following the Columbia Gorge breakaway at Cascade Locks, how often did the boat's operator start renewing the ropes used to tie it up?
items.expected_answer: The operating company began requiring the mooring lines to be replaced every year.

evidence.quote: As a result of the casualty, the operating company required mooring lines to be replaced annually.

items.notes: Tests a single post-casualty measure; the factual section also mentions a second measure (crewing/moving the vessel above 70-knot gusts), which the analysis quote omits.
